textarea.tan6ca910b0:
Bluetest has spent two decades turning complex OTA into fast, repeatable results. We pioneered reverberation-chamber OTA in 2000 and today partner with eight of the world’s ten largest handset makers, as well as leading operators, IoT, automotive, and defense innovators.

Our patented Reverberation Test System (RTS) chambers and Flow software compress verification cycles from hours to minutes, delivering TRP, TIS, and throughput in a realistic multipath environment without bulky positioners. RTS systems are purpose-built for modern wireless, from compact IoT and Wi-Fi devices in RTS25/RTS65 to large form-factor products and live-person testing in RTS95B.

Installed in 40+ countries and backed by the Flow platform (Manager, Touch, Analyzer) for automation and reporting, Bluetest is the proven path to confident OTA decisions, whether you’re optimizing a prototype or validating against the latest standards, including base-station methods in 3GPP TS38.141-2.
